scope: Complete original-IDO function match only; no image or ROM integration claim

independent_replay.method: Fresh copy in a clean directory; direct pinned IDO cc invocation; independently applied full-word HI16/LO16 arithmetic without score.relocate; canonical relocation cross-check also passes

compiler_identity.name: IDO 5.3 static-recomp v1.2
compiler_identity.note: Reused approved installed compiler; executable contents independently hashed

semantic_audit.input: No incoming argument register or stack slot is consumed; all inputs come from globals. No calls or stack frame.
semantic_audit.empty_case: A null free-list head returns null without modifying memory.
semantic_audit.allocation: Returns the previous free-list head, advances it to node->next, increments signed-half D_8012E66C, compares its reloaded signed-half result against D_8012E678, and updates the latter when greater.
semantic_audit.reset: Sets next and object pointers null; half fields at 4 and 8 to zero, half at 6 to -1; word at 20 to zero; float at 16 to positive zero. Pad bytes 10 and 11 are untouched.
semantic_audit.layout: O32 node size is 24 bytes; target-only compile-time assertions verify offsets 0,4,6,8,10,12,16,20 and size. Field names other than next remain neutral; original typedef names are not claimed.
semantic_audit.count_overflow: The native signed-half store/reload wraps 32767 to -32768. C narrowing is implementation-defined at that boundary; the pinned IDO exact body proves the target behavior. Host compiler behavior was separately checked.

direct_transfer_scan.limit: Protected direct transfers only; indirect callers and computed transfers are not excluded

semantic_audit.arcade_equivalent: Not established; accepted entity_transform_apply independently implements the complementary free-list push using the same link, counter and high-water globals.
semantic_audit.caller_window_review: All ten direct JAL windows reviewed; callers check v0 for null and use or preserve the returned node pointer. No incoming arguments are read by the callee.

host_semantics.coverage: Every signed-half counter value and four high-water boundaries; null and two-node free lists, one-node exhaustion, returned identity, all reset fields, untouched padding and untouched successor.
host_semantics.sanitizers: AddressSanitizer and UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer enabled; leak detection disabled because unsupported under sandbox ptrace. No dynamic allocation.
host_semantics.limit: Host semantics supplement native byte identity, not N64 execution; actual O32 layout is separately compiled under IDO.

independent_peer_review.source_difference: Only a trailing documentation comment was appended after the independently reviewed function; all reviewed C bytes are preserved verbatim. Publication replay independently verifies the final source.
independent_peer_review.method: Separate worktree source copy, canonical score, independent direct compiler replay and three-pair manual relocation arithmetic; complete-body ABI/semantic audit
